description: Curated interview question bank for general HR / behavioral interviews. Each question is tagged with a difficulty level and the skill dimension it probes.

questions.text: Tell me about yourself in two minutes.
Why do you want this role, and why this company?
What are your greatest strengths? Give an example of each in action.
How do you explain a complex technical idea to someone non-technical?
Tell me about a time you missed a deadline. What happened and what did you learn?
Describe a conflict you had with a teammate and how you handled it.
What is a weakness you are actively working on? What steps are you taking?
Tell me about a time you received difficult feedback. How did you respond?
Where do you see yourself in three years, and how does this role fit?
Describe a situation where you had to work with very little guidance. What did you do?
What accomplishment are you most proud of, and why?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager's decision. What did you do?
Describe a high-pressure situation at work or college and how you stayed effective.
Tell me about a time you had to persuade a group to change direction.
What would you do in your first 90 days if you joined us?
Tell me about a failure that taught you something important.
How do you prioritize when everything feels urgent?
Describe a time you mentored or taught someone else. What was hard about it?
Walk me through your resume, starting with the project you are most proud of.
What should a fresher put on a one-page resume, and what should they leave out?
Your resume lists a team project. What was your individual contribution, and how do you prove it?
Explain a gap or a weak semester in your academics honestly, without making excuses.
Convince me in two minutes that your projects prepared you for this exact role.
If I called your project guide, what would they say are your strengths and your one weakness?
Describe a time you worked in a team. What was your role?
What do you do when a teammate is not doing their share of the work?
Tell me about a disagreement you had with a teammate and how it was resolved.
How do you handle feedback or criticism on your work?
You are leading a team and the deadline is at risk. Walk me through your next three decisions.
Describe a time you had to learn something completely new under pressure to unblock your team.
